China has lodged a solemn protest with the Philippine ambassador, urging the Philippines to immediately rectify the situation and cease all smears and provocations—any further reckless acts will bear full responsibility for the severe consequences to bilateral relations.

quoted_tweet.text:
The Philippine side has long turned a blind eye to its Coast Guard “spokesperson” making inflammatory, confrontational, misleading and baseless remarks against China on maritime issues. China does not accept that. Head of Chinese MFA’s Department of Asian Affairs summoned Philippine Ambassador to China this morning to lodge serious protest.

Time for the Philippine side to undo the negative impact ASAP and stop tolerating the smear campaign and provocations, lest they disrupt normal diplomatic communication or further harm bilateral relations.
